Super Bowl LX was played on **February 8, 2026** at **Levi’s Stadium in Santa Clara, California**. The **Seattle Seahawks beat the New England Patriots 29–13**. Seattle led **3–0 after the first quarter, 9–0 at halftime, and 12–0 after three quarters**, then pulled away in the fourth.  
Sources: NFL game summary, NFL recap  
https://static.clubs.nfl.com/image/upload/patriots/ixew72ey6khgsxvpquw7.pdf  
https://www.nfl.com/news/sam-darnold-silences-skeptics-as-seahawks-dominate-patriots-in-super-bowl-lx

**How it unfolded**
- Seattle’s defense controlled most of the game.
- The Seahawks opened the scoring with field goals, then added a key **16-yard Sam Darnold-to-AJ Barner touchdown** early in the fourth.
- New England answered with a **35-yard Drake Maye-to-Mack Hollins TD**.
- Seattle then put it away with another field goal and a **45-yard Uchenna Nwosu interception return touchdown**.
- The Patriots added a late TD, but the outcome was settled.  
Source: NFL official game summary  
https://static.clubs.nfl.com/image/upload/patriots/ixew72ey6khgsxvpquw7.pdf

**Key performances**
- **Kenneth Walker III** won **Super Bowl MVP**.
- He had **135 rushing yards on 27 carries** plus **26 receiving yards**, for **161 scrimmage yards**.
- NFL noted he became the **first running back to win Super Bowl MVP since Terrell Davis**.  
Source: NFL MVP article  
https://www.nfl.com/news/seahawks-rb-kenneth-walker-iii-named-super-bowl-lx-mvp

**Team stats / game shape**
- Seattle had **141 rushing yards** to New England’s **79**.
- Total net yards were close: **335 for Seattle, 331 for New England**.
- The score was lopsided mainly because Seattle’s defense created game-swinging plays and kept New England scoreless for three quarters.  
Source: NFL official game summary  
https://static.clubs.nfl.com/image/upload/patriots/ixew72ey6khgsxvpquw7.pdf

**Bigger storylines**
- NFL.com framed it as a defensive masterpiece by Seattle and part of **Sam Darnold’s career resurgence**.
- The game averaged **124.9 million viewers**, making it the **second most-watched show in U.S. history** and NBCUniversal’s most-watched ever.  
Sources: NFL recap, NFL viewership  
https://www.nfl.com/news/sam-darnold-silences-skeptics-as-seahawks-dominate-patriots-in-super-bowl-lx  
https://www.nfl.com/news/super-bowl-lx-second-most-watched-all-time-with-nearly-125m-viewers

**Halftime show**
- **Bad Bunny** headlined.
- Reuters described it as a celebration of **Puerto Rican culture**, with a **Lady Gaga surprise appearance** and a tribute involving **Daddy Yankee**.  
Source: Reuters via Investing.com  
https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/nflbad-bunny-turns-super-bowl-halftime-into-puerto-rican-love-letter-with-lady-gaga-surprise-4492547
